entities.title: Browse current events by time and discovery context
entities.definition: A useful vertical slice that lets a user enter a current listing, scan real EventCards and open one matching event without a dynamic dependency.

confidence.basis: Production listings and acceptance inventory.

story_contract.context: A resident or visitor opens a public date, weekend, popular, unusual or home discovery route.
story_contract.vertical_slice: Static route → exposed current cards → canonical event open.
story_contract.observable_result: The user sees a coherent bounded listing and opens the matching event without horizontal overflow or a broken route.

unresolved_conflicts: Public root promotion and production-wide cards-to-value evidence remain open.

entities.title: Open a source-grounded curated event context
entities.definition: A vertical slice that presents an explicit collection, festival, exhibition or club context and lets the user open a member event without route-local membership invention.

confidence.basis: Routes and data contracts exist; quality and promotion differ by family.

story_contract.context: The user chooses a curated context rather than entering a free-form query.
story_contract.vertical_slice: Curated route → explicit criteria/membership → current event open.
story_contract.observable_result: Only accepted current members are shown; insufficient supply produces honest absence or fallback, not fabricated fillers.

unresolved_conflicts: Some semantic heads and public routes remain blocked pending owner gold and strict quality evidence.

entities.title: Continue from an event to related and diverse alternatives
entities.definition: A vertical slice that gives the user finite, deduplicated related and broader continuation after evaluating an event.

confidence.basis: Related graph and continuation contracts.

story_contract.context: The user reaches the continuation section after evaluating an event.
story_contract.vertical_slice: Current event → strict related cards → finite diverse broader cards → canonical event open.
story_contract.observable_result: No current/prior/hidden duplicate appears, related truth is not fabricated, and the broader section is finite.

unresolved_conflicts: Optional vector projection can be disabled or stale and must not be mislabeled as verified related content.

entities.title: Evaluate one event from coherent detail
entities.definition: A vertical slice that lets a user inspect current identity, media, summary, occurrence, admission, venue and transport before choosing a next action.

confidence.basis: Accepted event-detail family and scenario matrix.

story_contract.context: The user opened a promising event from any supported card surface.
story_contract.vertical_slice: Canonical event route → coherent detail facts/media → explicit decision/continuation actions.
story_contract.observable_result: Critical visible facts agree, media follows its semantic treatment, and the page supports a next decision without a broken mandatory block.

unresolved_conflicts: Decision confidence is not directly measured; public root release remains NO-GO.

entities.title: Search one intent and open one exact result
entities.definition: A vertical slice that accepts one user intent, issues exactly one bounded Search request, renders exact large cards, performs real scroll and opens one matching event.

confidence.basis: Accepted Stage 2 runtime health.

story_contract.context: A user can express a genre, time, activity or other Search intent.
story_contract.vertical_slice: Intent input → one vector-only POST → 1–5 exact cards → real scroll → matching event 200.
story_contract.observable_result: One physical request is made, result IDs equal rendered cards, forbidden LLM/pagination calls remain zero, and one event opens successfully.

unresolved_conflicts: Health proves a bounded flow, not target query-quality or user satisfaction distribution.

entities.title: Confirm whether exact Search results matched
entities.definition: A vertical slice that asks the user `matched` or `missed` only after the exact result boundary and separates fallback recommendations from Search results.

confidence.basis: Explicit owner brief and USR-14; production measurement coverage remains partial.

story_contract.context: The exact Search result stream has reached a terminal boundary.
story_contract.vertical_slice: Exact results or zero-result message → matched/missed feedback → separate alternative feed.
story_contract.observable_result: Feedback is not shown while exact pagination is active; fallback cards are never labeled exact results.

unresolved_conflicts: The downstream review/promotion pipeline for accepted searches is not considered completed by this story.

entities.title: Save one event idempotently
entities.definition: A vertical slice that saves the exact event once, reflects confirmed state across card/detail/Favorites and supports remove/undo without duplicate state.

confidence.basis: Acceptance and strong-action contracts; complete production evidence is missing.

story_contract.context: The user chooses to preserve an event for later.
story_contract.vertical_slice: Save command → durable acknowledgement → consistent saved state → Favorites recovery/removal.
story_contract.observable_result: Repeated save does not create a duplicate; the saved event is uniquely recoverable and removal/undo stays coherent.

unresolved_conflicts: Local/cloud reconciliation and account switching need accepted end-to-end evidence.

entities.title: Add the exact event occurrence to a calendar
entities.definition: A vertical slice that creates or opens a calendar artifact with correct title, timezone, start/end, named location, status and canonical event URL.

confidence.basis: ICS implementation and native/manual acceptance requirements.

story_contract.context: The user selected a specific event occurrence and wants it in an external calendar.
story_contract.vertical_slice: Occurrence selection → canonical ICS/calendar handoff → imported matching calendar item.
story_contract.observable_result: The calendar item matches visible event facts and does not silently use another occurrence or stale date.

unresolved_conflicts: Real OS/calendar-client imports are manual/native evidence and not uniformly attached to current releases.

entities.title: Share one canonical event safely
entities.definition: A vertical slice that invokes native share on supported mobile contexts or an accepted desktop clipboard fallback using the canonical current event URL and honest cancel/failure states.

confidence.basis: Explicit desktop/mobile user scenarios and share acceptance.

story_contract.context: The user wants to send the exact event to another person or application.
story_contract.vertical_slice: Share action → native or clipboard handoff → honest success/cancel/fallback state.
story_contract.observable_result: The shared target is the exact canonical event; unsupported, cancelled or denied APIs do not display false success.

unresolved_conflicts: Native system share and clipboard behavior require real OS evidence beyond Playwright mocks.

entities.title: Open a usable route or transport option
entities.definition: A vertical slice that shows transport only when eligible and opens the named event location or a feasible there/back transport chain with freshness and failure honesty.

confidence.basis: User route/transport scenarios and implemented transport components.

story_contract.context: The event has a named place and may have supported out-of-city transport.
story_contract.vertical_slice: Eligibility/freshness → visible route or transport context → exact map/transfer handoff.
story_contract.observable_result: The destination is the named event location; promised transport is feasible and stale/partial providers do not fabricate a route.

unresolved_conflicts: Real maps and transport-provider native handoff/freshness evidence is incomplete.

entities.title: Return to current saved events
entities.definition: A vertical slice that opens Favorites in the current identity context, shows unique lifecycle-aware saved events and allows continuation or removal.

confidence.basis: Acceptance and reconstructed UI states with incomplete runtime closure.

story_contract.context: The user previously saved one or more events and returns later.
story_contract.vertical_slice: Favorites route → identity/state reconciliation → current saved list → open/remove/undo.
story_contract.observable_result: Every event appears once with truthful upcoming/moved/cancelled/ended state and no cross-account data.

unresolved_conflicts: Account switching, merge and multi-device evidence remain open.

entities.title: Use a safe personal or contextual feed
entities.definition: A vertical slice that resolves feed mode, renders a non-empty bounded current feed and records explicit strong actions without making the base service depend on profile availability.

confidence.basis: Target contract and route exist; outcome uplift is not proven.

story_contract.context: The user opens `/dlya-menya/` with no profile, a cold profile or a compatible mature profile.
story_contract.vertical_slice: Mode resolution → safe static/contextual/personalized feed → event open or strong action.
story_contract.observable_result: The feed is non-empty when eligible supply exists, the mode is honest, <=30 and diversity are measurable, and incompatible state falls back safely.

unresolved_conflicts: No accepted randomized uplift and no full production mode coverage.

entities.title: Mark an event not interesting and undo safely
entities.definition: A vertical slice that turns the card into a clear non-navigation state, records one authoritative semantic signal and restores the same event on undo without duplicate or diagnostic profile write-back.

confidence.basis: Explicit personalization acceptance and signal contracts.

story_contract.context: The user explicitly rejects an event in a discovery feed.
story_contract.vertical_slice: Hide intent → authoritative state → non-navigation replacement → undo restoration → next-feed policy.
story_contract.observable_result: One semantic hide is stored, undo restores the same card/state, retries do not duplicate, and action-map observations never mutate the profile.

unresolved_conflicts: Cross-tab and backend/profile projection evidence remains incomplete.

entities.title: Continue when an optional dynamic capability fails
entities.definition: A vertical slice that keeps static content usable, shows a typed failure and provides a bounded retry or alternative without duplicate commands or false success.

confidence.basis: Static/degraded and Search failure contracts.

story_contract.context: Search, personalization, analytics, media or another optional dependency is unavailable or stale.
story_contract.vertical_slice: Typed failure → static/last-good preservation → explanation → retry or alternate route.
story_contract.observable_result: Core content and navigation remain usable; failed optional work does not erase state or report success.
implementation_evidence: static fallback and typed runtime states

unresolved_conflicts: Coverage is capability- and context-specific, not one global recovery status.

entities.title: Submit bounded product or event feedback with durable acknowledgement
entities.definition: A vertical slice that lets an eligible participant submit one typed feedback record, preserves privacy and delivery evidence and returns honest accepted/pending/failed state.

confidence.basis: Focus and analytics contracts with differing production maturity.

story_contract.context: A focus-group or accepted feedback surface asks for usefulness, improvement, event issue or service feedback.
story_contract.vertical_slice: Typed feedback → privacy-safe durable command/outbox → acknowledgement → operator triage reference.
story_contract.observable_result: The interface distinguishes accepted, pending and failed delivery; text/screenshots remain in the protected feedback contour.

unresolved_conflicts: Focus-group prototype and general event/service feedback are separate contracts and cannot be globally marked deployed.

entities.title: Curate and repair the current event catalog
entities.definition: Review source evidence, event identity, lifecycle, occurrence, admission, media and relation conflicts so only truthful eligible events reach public projections.

confidence.basis: Data-prep, incident and release contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Manual repair and automated pipelines still encounter lifecycle and source-ownership edge cases.

entities.title: Review, accept or reject an immutable static candidate
entities.definition: Resolve exact source/snapshot/build/manifest identities, inspect release evidence, reject failed candidates and preserve rollback before any root promotion.

confidence.basis: Release plan and candidate evidence.

unresolved_conflicts: Live root promotion infrastructure and rollback drill are not accepted.

entities.title: Monitor critical data progression and downstream consumption
entities.definition: Confirm every due producer observed its upstream, produced a fresh or checked no-change receipt and was consumed by the exact static candidate; investigate stalled or blocked pipelines.

confidence.basis: Explicit release-blocking gate.

unresolved_conflicts: Required registry, schedule, three terminal PASS days and failure drills remain release blockers.

entities.title: Monitor accepted product runtime health
entities.definition: Review typed health receipts, release identity, queues, errors, resource budgets and last-complete evidence without confusing missing telemetry with health.

confidence.basis: Search health, analytics and operations contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Search health is accepted but unified product analytics and critical data progression are incomplete.

entities.title: Contain, repair and close a production incident
entities.definition: Stop harmful side effects, preserve bounded evidence, repair authoritative state, deploy a reviewed fix, verify production and close with prevention evidence.

confidence.basis: Incident management contract and latest closed incident.

unresolved_conflicts: Closure of one incident does not prove the capability globally healthy or recurrence impossible.

entities.title: Triage, assign and resolve product feedback
entities.definition: Review protected feedback by purpose and affected product/UI identity, deduplicate causes, assign ownership and trace repair/verification without treating each comment as an automatic UI task.

confidence.basis: Feedback and Product Atlas operating contracts; unified production workflow incomplete.

unresolved_conflicts: Feedback modes and persistence owners differ; no single cross-surface SLA is accepted.

entities.title: Review evidence, findings and decisions
entities.definition: Start from a measurement question, inspect immutable evidence and limitations, accept/reject/mark insufficient a finding, record a decision and define follow-up.

confidence.basis: Product methodology, analysis and action-map contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: This v1 registry exposes missing evidence but does not itself fill outcome measurements.

entities.title: Maintain exact Product Atlas ↔ UI SoT links
entities.definition: Resolve locked product and corrected UI revisions, validate route/archetype/region/component/state foreign keys, preserve route-specific context and leave unpublished bindings pending.

confidence.basis: Current Product Atlas task and corrected semantic UI SoT.

unresolved_conflicts: Penpot bindings remain pending until an explicit MCP materialization pass after the applicable parity gate.
